drug_class: Topical antiseptic and skin protectant combination
purpose: This combination product is used to soothe, protect, and cleanse minor skin irritations, cuts, scrapes, and rashes. It helps relieve itching and discomfort on the skin. It is also commonly used for vaginal area irritation and minor feminine itching.
how_it_works: Benzethonium chloride is an antiseptic ingredient that kills germs and bacteria on the skin to help prevent infection. Allantoin is a soothing skin protectant that helps calm irritated skin and supports the skin's natural healing process. Together, they work to clean, protect, and comfort irritated or minor wounded skin.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this product well. Some people may notice mild temporary stinging, redness, or a slight burning feeling right after applying it. Skin irritation or a mild rash can occasionally occur, especially if you use it too often.
warnings: Do not use this product in your eyes or inside body openings. Stop using it and talk to your doctor if your symptoms get worse, do not improve within 7 days, or if you develop a rash or allergic reaction like swelling or difficulty breathing. Do not use on deep wounds, animal bites, or serious burns. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, check with your doctor before using.
typical_dosing: Apply a small amount to the affected skin area up to 3 to 4 times per day, or as directed on the product label. Clean the area first, then gently apply. Do not cover with a tight bandage unless your doctor tells you to. Always follow the directions on the specific product you are using.
